title: sensitive/skip globs match nothing in this repo, so the deep security pass never fires on the risky files
evidence: REVIEW.md:14-20 lists **/install.sh, **/release.sh, **/auth/**, **/*.min.js and **/*.snap, none of which match any file in the tree; they look like the plugin's template defaults. The files that actually carry risk go unlisted: src/claude.ts (runs the claude binary), src/edits.ts (hidden edit-* subcommands that write settings), src/shell.ts (pty command runner), src/session.ts (permissionMode, canUseTool) and src/settings.ts.
fix: Replace the sensitive list with the real risky paths (src/session.ts, src/claude.ts, src/edits.ts, src/shell.ts, src/settings.ts) and drop the skip entries that match nothing.
verified: git ls-files (87 files) has no install.sh, release.sh, auth path, .min.js or .snap, so the sensitive and skip globs match nothing; risky files such as src/session.ts, src/edits.ts get no deep security pass.
